sources.snippet: WavLM-Base-Plus Microsoft's WavLM The base model pretrained on 16kHz sampled speech audio. When using the model, make sure that your speech input is also sampled at 16kHz. Note: This model does not have a tokenizer as it was pretrained on audio alone.
